But, when intense media pressure and giddy politics rule over rational, sober safety concerns (extreme ice hanging off Challenger pre-launch, unsafe launch temps, etc.), prompts a 'devil may care' attitude, like the Titanic sinking, completely avoidable tragedies can and often do happen. Millions of Americans today are still angry that NASA was NEVER held personally responsible for this debacle. That's right. NO ONE at NASA ever not charged with any criminal or civil charges related to the Challenger disaster. While the Rogers Commission faulted NASA’s management and engineering culture for the accident, no criminal prosecutions were pursued against NASA officials or employees. The power of 'giddy politics' over sane safety measures gave NASA a free pass in spite of their obvious guilt in this completely avoidable tragedy of epic proportions.
